answer: Give each new key a booked ten-minute bouldering-lane slot and a randomly set route tagged marble/lotus/canyon. A staff judge verifies the start, top hold and finish time, signs the one-use lane QR, and the registry consumes that gym/route slot, rejecting replayed scans or out-of-window logs. Proposed lane-and-judging fee is .20 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .20 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,200 (1,000 × .20). Limitation: climbing ability and gym access vary, and staff may collude.
